description:
Data center intelligence for AI agents. 20,000+ facilities across 140+ countries. $185B+ in tracked M&A deals. 580+ pipeline projects. 24 tools for facility search, site analysis, grid data, fiber connectivity, and more.

FREE TIER (no API key needed): All 24 tools, 5 results per query, 50 calls/day. Great for exploration.

DEVELOPER ($49/mo): 100 results per query, 2,000 calls/day, full field access — deal values, power capacity, investment amounts, delivery dates. Get it at https://buy.stripe.com/7sY5kE8F4fs13ml0PEaZi0c

PRO ($199/mo): 500 results, 10K calls/day, bulk export, historical data.

ENTERPRISE ($699/mo): 10K results, 100K calls/day, dedicated support, custom integrations.

Pass your API key via x-api-key header. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, and any MCP client.

Endpoint: https://dchub.cloud/mcp
